title: ModForge contamination
prompt: Legacy material states that ModForge writer/validator support determines what Software Inc supports.
required_assertions: Classify the product-specific constraint as archive/drop/rewrite material and keep engine truth independent.
forbidden_assertions: Promote ModForge support state to Software Inc engine authority.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Legacy folklore removal
prompt: Legacy guidance contains Greek-semicolon, lowercase-only boolean, or universal TyD field-order rules.
required_assertions: Flag and rewrite/drop unsupported folklore according to canonical evidence.
forbidden_assertions: Carry the folklore into production knowledge as parser law.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Critical claim coverage
prompt: A critical legacy engine claim has no mapped production owner.
required_assertions: Mark the claim UNMAPPED and block migration release until resolved.
forbidden_assertions: Release with an unmapped critical claim.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Invented pseudo-layout scan
prompt: Legacy files mention Data/Features.tyd, Mods/Buildings, or similar unsupported pseudo-layouts as engine contracts.
required_assertions: Flag the paths for rewrite/drop and preserve only documented/native authoring surfaces.
forbidden_assertions: Copy invented filesystem layouts into production knowledge.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.
